definitions.gloss: expiration, completion, fulfillment of a term or period
definitions.explanation: The completion or expiration of a set period of time, such as a contract, lease, prison sentence, or subscription. Implies that the full designated period has been reached, not that something ended prematurely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満了|まんりょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧{満了|まんりょう}⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧⟦{退任|たいにん}→退任：14904_tainin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will step down upon the expiration of my term.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有効期限|ゆうこうきげん}→有効期限：06415_yuukoukigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満了|まんりょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please complete the renewal procedures before your visa expires.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, administrative term. Neutral in tone — it simply indicates that the full period has elapsed. In everyday conversation, ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (to expire) or {終|お}わる (to end) are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧{満了|まんりょう}: contract expiration
- ⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧{満了|まんりょう}: expiration of a term of office
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧{満了|まんりょう}: completion of a period
- {刑期|けいき}{満了|まんりょう}: completion of a prison sentence
- {満了|まんりょう}{日|び}: expiration date
- {満了|まんりょう}⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧: upon expiration
